title: 中元

series.next: Season one is over. 804 is quiet. Mostly.

setting: Flat 804, midnight on the fifteenth of the seventh month. The fog is down to the third floor.

sun.name: 孙奶奶
sun.en: an old woman who lived in 804 twenty years ago

steps.narr: Midnight on the fifteenth. A knock.

steps.en: I'm right here. Don't be scared.

else.narr: Only the hallway light, and the knock.

steps.en: 小安... 小安, is that you?

say.en: Answer her. Tell her you're here.
say.gloss: I'm here. I can hear you.
say.tip: 我在 wǒ zài = I'm here: what you say when someone calls you. 听得见 = can hear.

miss.narr: You can't make yourself say it. She knocks once more, softly.

answers: 我在，我一直都听得见您。
我在，您叫我一直都听得见。
3.gloss: I'm here. I've heard you all along.
3.tip: 一直 yìzhí = all along, the whole time.

say.en: Ask her who 小安 is.
say.tip: ……是谁？ = who is ...? 您说的 = the one you mean.

ok.zh: 去了国外，就不打电话了。

miss.en: 小安 is the child I raised.

answers: 奶奶，您一直在叫的小安是谁？
奶奶，您一直叫的小安是谁啊？
3.gloss: Granny, who is the 小安 you've been calling all this time?

steps.narr: She was never calling you. She was calling 小安.

say.en: Tell her the truth, or let her have 小安 home.
say.gloss: I'm not 小安. But I'm here.
say.tip: 但 dàn = but: 我不是小安，但我在。

ok.en: Then come and sit with me, now and then.

alts.en: Or: be 小安 for her, tonight

then.en: You're home. That's all that matters.

alts.en: Tell her the 汤圆 were good
alts.gloss: Granny, the 汤圆 were lovely.

then.narr: For the first time in twenty years, someone hears her laugh.
You set a bowl of 汤圆 outside the door.
Morning. Every note in 804 is gone.
Under the door, one new note, in a shaky hand.

then.en: The bowl is empty, and washed. Next year you'll make the 汤圆 yourself. 🥣

answers: 我不是小安，但我在，我陪您。
我不是小安，可我在，我陪着您。
3.gloss: I'm not 小安, but I'm here, and I'll keep you company.

answers: 奶奶，我回来了，让您久等了。
奶奶，我回来了，让您等久了。
alts.gloss: Granny, I'm home. Sorry I kept you waiting.

steps.narr: You set a bowl of 汤圆 outside the door.
Morning. Every note in 804 is gone.
Under the door, one new note, in a shaky hand.

steps.en: For one night, 小安 came home. The hallway light stays on till dawn. 💡

else.en: Not 小安, but someone answered. 804 is quiet now. 🌙
